name: Do I need special primer for a bathroom?
description: Yes, use a high-humidity primer in bathrooms for better adhesion, stain blocking, mildew resistance, and paint longevity.

mainEntity.name: Do I need special primer for a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, using a high-quality primer specifically designed for high-humidity environments is advisable in bathrooms. These primers offer excellent adhesion, block stains, and crucially, provide mildew resistance. They create a solid base for your topcoat, preventing paint from peeling or blistering due to moisture. A good primer can significantly extend the life and appearance of your bathroom paint job.
